conversation.text: You tapped "Little support". What is happening?

Hey, it's just that my team lead is on calls with Europe pretty much all day. When I get stuck on things like billing disputes, my Teams messages don't usually get answered until the next morning. Yesterday, a customer credit note ended up waiting two days for review. I think it would really help if we could set up a quick 15-minute daily check-in with my lead, or maybe assign a backup person I can reach out to with questions.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reports delays in receiving responses from their team lead on billing disputes due to schedule conflicts, causing tasks to wait for review. [MANAGER_SUPPORT] "my Teams messages don't usually get answered until the next morning"
